_source.per_level: vmangos world DB: player_classlevelstats (class=1) for base_health/base_mana; player_crit_per_agility and player_dodge_per_agility (class=1) for the agility divisors. Read by ObjectMgr::LoadPlayerInfo / ObjectMgr::GetPlayerCritPerAgility / GetPlayerDodgePerAgility.
_source.race_base_stats: vmangos world DB: player_levelstats (class=1). Naked base stats per race per level, before gear/buffs.

_interpolated_note: Level 59 is missing from both agility tables in the vmangos DB; ObjectMgr::LoadPlayerInfo fills gaps by linear interpolation between neighbours, which is what per_level holds for level 59.
_derived_check_rows_note: naked_checks are derived with the formulas in the doc (vmangos StatSystem.cpp) and double as test vectors.
